meta.box_convention: half-open [x1, y1, x2, y2) in canvas pixels, tight around ink at or above 32, amodal

runtime.reason: a real training step measured 0.043s, so one epoch of the stride-8 arm costs 4.0s; tier FULL is the largest arm list predicted to fit 40 minutes (the brief's calibration model ran at 1.47x its stated 5.0s)
assumptions: the cost of one training step is MEASURED on this article's own network, data and loss, not extrapolated from the calibration model, which was a factor of 1.8 out
the stride-4 and stride-16 arms are costed by their multiply accumulates relative to stride 8, which compares like with like
target assignment is identical every epoch, so it is computed once per anchor set and cached

dataset.name: fashion scenes
limits: compositing is a pixel-wise maximum, so there is no occlusion and every box is amodal
objects lie fully inside the canvas, so there is no truncation and the outer ring of cells receives almost no positives
boxes carry no annotation noise, the images are single-channel, and the splits are drawn from one distribution
the five classes were chosen for aspect diversity, so the anchor effect measured in E3 is an upper bound for this kind of data

grid.ceiling_note: with w = prior * exp(clamp(t, -4, 4)) every size is reachable and an object's centre always lies in its own cell, so the only ceiling is slot capacity; the prior-only column is the weaker quantity usually quoted

arm_control: trunk, dataset, seed, epochs, batch, optimiser, schedule, loss weights, box parameterisation, score floor and evaluation protocol are identical in every arm; the arm's id names the one thing that changed

verdicts.note: larger than the seed spread (spread measured over 3 seeds)
larger than the seed spread (spread measured over 3 seeds)
smaller than the seed spread, so not resolved by this experiment (spread measured over 3 seeds)
smaller than the seed spread, so not resolved by this experiment (spread measured over 3 seeds)
larger than the seed spread (spread measured over 3 seeds)

nms.cost_note: pair_tests is the number of pairwise IoU tests suppression performed over the whole split, which is its own cost

reliability.event: the event is 'this surviving detection matches an unmatched ground-truth box of its own class at IoU >= 0.5 under the confidence-sorted greedy matching used for mAP'

two_stage.declared: a 20 px box on a stride-8 map covers 2.5 cells, so the gain from a second stage here is expected to be small

failures.order: duplicate, then wrong class, then poor localisation, then held-out distractor, then background
failures.note: a miss that was present in the raw grid was thrown away by scoring or suppression, not by the head

sharing.note: the sharing factor IS the overlap factor up to border effects

factors.name: one shape scanned against one pass of the detector

windows.attribution_note: the product of the three factors reconstructs the total by construction, which is the reason it must not be attributed to any one of them

equivalence.note: an unpadded network computes the same function on a crop and on a cell of the full map; a padded one does not, and the disagreement lives on the border cells

viola_jones.note: mean_evaluated appears twice in article 19 with different values: over a whole photograph's windows, and over its own held-out set. Both are carried here.

eval.protocol: detections pooled across the split, sorted by confidence descending within class with ties broken by image then slot, matched to the highest-IoU unmatched ground-truth box of the same class in the same image, each ground-truth box consumed at most once

bootstrap.why: matching is within-image, so resampling whole images preserves the true-positive labels exactly

loss.box: smooth L1 on the sigmoid offsets and on the log size ratios, each term normalised by its own count
loss.ignore_rule: a non-assigned slot whose decoded box reaches IoU > 0.5 with any object contributes no objectness gradient
loss.optimiser: SGD momentum 0.9, lr 0.02, weight decay 5e-4, 2 warmup epochs, x0.1 at 60% and x0.01 at 85%
loss.guard: gradient norm clipped at 10, loss asserted finite every step, one restart at half the learning rate on a non-finite loss
